about: Expected code hashes of the live Radix packages built from this repository, and the recipe that rebuilds each one. Read by scripts/verify-package-parity.mjs and .github/workflows/package-parity.yml; explained in docs/AUDITOR-GUIDE.md section 5. wasm_sha256 is sha256sum of the package's .wasm; code_hash_blake2b256 is the Gateway's code_hash_hex. status 'verified' is written only after a CI rebuild matched the chain byte for byte (verified_in links that run); enforce=true makes a later mismatch fail CI.

recipe.os: Linux x86_64 (the wasm cannot be built correctly on macOS)
recipe.rust: 1.92.0 via rustup, components rust-src and rustfmt, target wasm32-unknown-unknown
recipe.scrypto_cli: radix-clis 1.3.1, installed with: cargo install radix-clis --version 1.3.1 --locked
recipe.command: scrypto build, run in the package directory with SCRYPTO_CARGO_LOCKED=true and the committed Cargo.lock
recipe.homes: CARGO_HOME=/root/.cargo and RUSTUP_HOME=/root/.rustup. The deployed wasm embeds source paths under both directories (panic location strings), so a build under any other home produces different bytes
